name: aixio-api
description: Aixio Designer: design with an image model, extract editable layers, and build websites, apps, games and visual artifacts with your agent.

defaultPrompt: Use Aixio Designer to design and build a website from these product photos.
Use Aixio Designer to design a game screen and implement it in my project.
Use Aixio Image to Layer to convert this poster into editable layers.
interface.longDescription: Aixio Designer combines image generation and Aixio Image to Layer with instructions for your coding agent. Design websites, app screens, game screens, posters and slides, then build from extracted image pieces and editable text using your agent's own tools. Sign in with your existing Aixio account. The full design pipeline runs two paid jobs after authorization. Inspect partial results and flattened fallbacks honestly, and preview the implementation against its mockup.
